unit: Geometry · Chapter VIII. Coordinates and vectors
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 9 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Polygon rule: lay off each vector from the end of the previous one; the sum runs from the first start to the last end.
stages.headlineEnglish: Polygon rule: lay off each vector from the end of the previous one; the sum runs from the first start to the last end.

stages.headline: If the chain closes up, the sum is the zero vector: AB + BC + CA = 0.
stages.headlineEnglish: If the chain closes up, the sum is the zero vector: AB + BC + CA = 0.

stages.headline: Terms may be reordered and grouped freely: AB + CD + BC = AB + BC + CD = AD.
stages.headlineEnglish: Terms may be reordered and grouped freely: AB + CD + BC = AB + BC + CD = AD.

stages.headline: Simplify MN + NP + PQ + QM.
stages.customInstructions: The answer is the zero vector.

stages.headline: Simplify AB + CD + BC.
stages.customInstructions: The answer is the vector AD.

stages.headline: Simplify KL + MN + LM + NP.
stages.customInstructions: The answer is the vector KP.
